reviewItem.question: For "Other Changes: There are many other PRs which were merged in this release cycle and we'd encourage you to read the release notes below", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether the operator filters cert-manager log lines with grep or similar text matching on the old log format

proposed.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds more structured logging information to some log lines, so those lines have a new format and log filters that use grep or similar tools may stop matching.
